item.title: Authorities say missing Navajo Nation girl who was found dead may have been hit by car
item.description: An 8-year-old girl from the Navajo Nation who was found dead in January may have been hit by a car, authorities said Wednesday.

item.title: Jeff Galloway, who inspired people with his run-walk method, dies at 80
item.description: Jeff Galloway, a member of the 1972 U.S. Olympic team who for decades inspired elite athletes and countless everyday runners by promoting a run-walk-run strategy, whether in a marathon or just a neighborhood jog, died Wednesday at age 80. item.title: Scottsdale police make 173 arrests during weekslong human trafficking operation
item.description: The Scottsdale Police Department made 173 arrests during a weekslong human trafficking operation, it announced Wednesday.

item.title: Most Americans see Iran as an enemy but doubt Trump’s judgment on military force, AP-NORC poll finds
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — As the U.S. and Iran head into their next round of nuclear talks in Geneva, a new AP-NORC poll finds that many U.S. adults continue to view Iran’s nuclear program as a threat — but they also don’t have high trust in President Donald Trump’s judgment on the use of military force […]

item.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia asks US judge in Tennessee to dismiss his criminal case, saying it’s vindictive

item.title: Judge orders changes to Columbia and Snake river dam operations to help ‘disappearing’ salmon
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — A federal judge in Oregon late Wednesday ordered narrow changes to hydropower dam operations on the Columbia and Snake rivers in the Pacific Northwest in order to help salmon, saying that the Trump administration’s plans for the massive structures would harm salmon runs that are “disappearing from the landscape.” The ruling […]

item.title: SAFE Alert canceled after missing 71-year-old Phoenix woman found safe
item.description: Authorities canceled a SAFE Alert on Wednesday after a missing 71-year-old Phoenix woman was found safe.
